A medium-trajectory grenade that attaches to surfaces and projects a laser every ? seconds. Sticking to a non-surface immediately triggers the Tripmine.

It triggers when an enemy is within its scanning cone, or after being attached for 10 seconds. The scanning cone extends up to 10 meters away, with a radius of 7 meters.

It explodes 1 second after triggering, or upon being destroyed, dealing up to <pve 805 /> <pvp [140] /> damage to enemies within ? meters and applying 40+20 stacks of <solar Scorch />.
